title: Code space
description: The retail .text is full, so the patches put their code in the zero slack at the end of .text (0x792CE0 to 0x793000) and of .rdata (0x80A600 to 0x80B000). These PE header edits make that slack part of an executable section. Every entry with a cave needs this one.

items.change: Make the slack at the end of .text and .rdata executable

edits.note: .text section header: VirtualSize 0x391CE0 -> 0x392000, so the caves up to 0x793000 lie inside the section
.rdata section header: VirtualSize 0x7755E -> 0x78000 (its raw size), so the slack up to 0x80B000 is mapped
